info.name: Blinker - Embedded Insurance API
info.description:
Embedded Insurance (EI) is an innovative platform that  revolutionizes the legacy insurance model into a seamless customer experience and provides the right insurance at the point of need.

The EI API is organized around [REST](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_State_Transfer). Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts [JSON ](http://www.json.org/) request bodies and returns JSON responses The API uses standard HTTP response codes and authentication.

We have designed with simplicity in mind. Use exactly the same setup in different environments, just pass isTest at the root of the request and we will deal with it appropriately.

**HTTP Responses and Errors**

EI uses conventional HTTP response codes to indicate the success or failure of an API request.

Codes in the `2xx` range indicate success.

Codes in the `4xx` range indicate an error that failed given the information provided (e.g duplicate lead received, missing data). Where possible suitable error messages are returned.

The base URL for the API is: [https://api.embeddedinsurance.com](https://api.embeddedinsurance.com)

We are determined to build a first class developer experience so welcome any feedback and are always looking to improve.

request.description:
The Auth URL is: [https://auth.embeddedinsurance.com/oauth2/token](https://auth.embeddedinsurance.com/oauth2/token)

The EI API uses a client_id, client_secret and grant_type. These will be provided to you through a one time link during the partner onboarding process.

Keep these credentials secure - they provide a number of privileges. Do not share these credentials in accessible areas such as GitHub, client-side code etc.
Returns a one-time link to the Embedded Insurance microsite.

Returns the health of the API

Example 200 response:

``` json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "timestamp": "2025-03-05T16:00:08.501Z",
  "requestId": "d7fd4c23-b6d6-4ef9-89a4-e4e14134e863",
  "version": "1.0.0"
}

 ```
